# A native call only a page's loop variable makes constant is answered before
# the first document is written, one batch per round, and a later round
# probes again the documents that asked. A page that the round skipped would
# still come out right, answered one call at a time, so the round lines are
# what this asserts.
exec sh -c 'printf "module example.com/app\n\ngo %s\n\nrequire duckfam.us/sngl v0.0.0\n\nreplace duckfam.us/sngl => %s\n" "$(sed -n "s/^go //p" "$SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD")" "${SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD%/go.mod}" > go.mod && sed -n "/^require (/,/^)/p" "$SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD" >> go.mod'
env GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod
exec go mod tidy
env SNGL_GENCACHE_DIR=$WORK/store

# A call whose argument is another call's answer takes a second round, for
# the one page that makes it.
sngl -v generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-eval=go:example.com/app/lib nested.sngl
stderr -count=2 'consteval round.*calls=1'
grep 'twice 8' out/two/index.html
grep 'plain 1' out/index.html
grep 'plain 3' out/three/index.html

# Pages under a loop over a call's answer are not known until it is answered,
# so the round that asks for it finds no pages; the next probes every page,
# and their calls are one batch.
sngl -v generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out2 --allow-eval=go:example.com/app/lib iterated.sngl
stderr 'consteval round.*calls=2'
stderr 'consteval round.*calls=3'
grep '/!' out2/index.html
grep '/a!' out2/a/index.html
grep '/b!' out2/b/index.html

-- nested.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import lib "go:example.com/app/lib"

struct P {
    n int
    href string
}

const pages = [P{n=1, href="/"}, P{n=2, href="/two"}, P{n=3, href="/three"}]

ui.window(title="t") {
    nav.stack #stack {
        for var p = pages {
            nav.page(href=p.href, title="p") {
                if p.n == 2 {
                    ui.text(value="twice {lib.Double(lib.Double(p.n))}")
                } else {
                    ui.text(value="plain {p.n}")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
-- iterated.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import lib "go:example.com/app/lib"

const groups = [1, 2]

ui.window(title="t") {
    nav.stack #stack {
        for var g = groups {
            for var h = lib.Hrefs(g) {
                nav.page(href=h, title="p") {
                    ui.text(value=lib.Shout(h))
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
-- lib/lib.go --
package lib

//sngl:pure
func Double(n int) int { return n * 2 }

//sngl:pure
func Shout(s string) string { return s + "!" }

//sngl:pure
func Hrefs(g int) []string {
	if g == 1 {
		return []string{"/", "/a"}
	}
	return []string{"/b"}
}
